title: Fine-Tuning Whisper for Automatic Speech Recognition in Baniwa: A Preliminary Study
abstract: arXiv:2608.26060v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) technologies have achieved remarkable performance in recent years through the use of large multilingual foundation models. However, most advances remain concentrated on high-resource languages, while indigenous languages continue to suffer from a lack of speech resources and language technologies. This work presents a preliminary study on the adaptation of Whisper for Automatic Speech Recognition in Baniwa, an indigenous Arawakan language spoken in Brazil, Colombia, and Venezuela. The experiments were conducted using a corpus of 1,373 manually transcribed recordings obtained from a linguistic documentation project. The corpus contains approximately 0.54 hours of speech and consists primarily of isolated words and short elicited utterances. translated_title: 微调Whisper用于巴尼瓦语的自动语音识别：初步研究
translated_abstract: 自动语音识别（ASR）技术近年来通过使用大型多语言基础模型取得了显著性能提升。然而，大多数进展仍集中在高资源语言上，而土著语言则持续面临语音资源和语言技术的匮乏。本研究针对Whisper模型在巴尼瓦语（一种在巴西、哥伦比亚和委内瑞拉使用的阿拉瓦克语系土著语言）自动语音识别中的适应性进行了初步探索。实验使用了从语言文献项目中获得的1,373条手动转录录音语料库，该语料库包含约0.54小时的语音，主要由孤立词汇和简短的诱导性语句组成。通过监督学习对Whisper Small模型进行了微调，并使用词错误率（WER）和字符错误率（CER）进行评估。最佳模型实现了W（词错误率）...（摘要不完整，但已翻译主要部分）
tldr: 本研究首次尝试微调Whisper模型用于巴尼瓦语ASR，利用小规模语料库验证了其可行性，并报告了初步的WER和CER结果。
en_tdlr: This study presents a preliminary attempt to fine-tune Whisper for Baniwa ASR, demonstrating feasibility with a small corpus and reporting initial WER and CER results.
